lessons.correction: Continue developing economy and technology while maintaining flexibility. Strengthen ground forces as a baseline, but keep options open for air transition.
lessons.mistake: Committing to a specific army composition before scouting the opponent's tech path, or neglecting defense while focusing on economy.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when you have scouted the opponent's tech path or when your army composition becomes defined.
lessons.title: Avoid early army commitment
lessons.when: Early game, own economy and tech heavy, production moderate, opponent ground-based with light air.
lessons.why: Early game is about establishing a strong economic and technological foundation. Committing too early to a specific army composition can be punished by scouting and adaptation.

lessons.correction: Increase air presence and strengthen air forces. Continue developing technology and economy, but ensure ground defense is not neglected.
lessons.mistake: Over-committing to air while neglecting ground defense, or failing to adapt if the opponent shows anti-air.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's tech choice or if they commit to anti-air.
lessons.title: Balance air commitment with ground defense
lessons.when: Early-midgame, own army air-oriented with Oracles, heavy production and tech, opponent ground-based with light air.
lessons.why: Oracles provide harassment and scouting, and can transition into Phoenix or Void Ray compositions. Air can be strong against ground-based Zerg, but ground defense remains essential.

lessons.correction: Strengthen ground forces and maintain Void Rays for anti-air. Continue developing technology and economy.
lessons.mistake: Over-committing to Void Rays if the opponent has many Corruptors, or neglecting ground defense.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's tech choice or if they commit to air.
lessons.title: Maintain balanced ground and air forces
lessons.when: Midgame, own army ground-oriented with Zealots and Void Rays, opponent ground-based with Zerglings, Mutalisks, Corruptors, and Queens.
lessons.why: Void Rays provide anti-air and can be effective against Corruptors. A balanced army can handle mixed compositions.
